propertyTargetingDefect.evidence: backend src/services/featureFlags/provider.js calls getAllFlags(String(userId), {}, {}) with EMPTY person properties. PostHog flags with person-property release conditions (e.g. email icontains humai-internal.test — the internal-tester pattern used by mobile_score_breakdown and others) can NEVER evaluate true because the properties being matched are never supplied.
propertyTargetingDefect.provenBy: mobile_score_breakdown ACTIVE with email icontains humai-internal.test rollout 100% evaluated FALSE for a probe user whose email matches humai-internal.test exactly, while plain-rollout flags flip correctly within seconds
propertyTargetingDefect.impact: all internal-tester-targeted rollouts are silently dead — internal testers evaluate production-default false; any gradual/targeted rollout by person property is inert
propertyTargetingDefect.remediation: pass person properties (email at minimum) into getAllFlags evaluation call, or move targeting to server-side group keys the backend actually supplies
